description: The media server classroom voice uses on this computer for an offline lab or classroom. Only the room's Owner needs it; it runs only while you start it.
notes: The official LiveKit server release for Windows x64 from GitHub; SHA256 from the release's checksums.txt. Downloaded only when you install it here (never part of the installer). Nothing is added to PATH and no service is installed: OpenMind starts it with a fresh key for each run, bound to one address of this computer, and stops it with the app.
